description: This file contains bash functions for managing git worktrees related to pull requests, including functions to initialize repository root, enter worktrees, fetch PR metadata, write metadata files, list PR worktrees, and clean up old worktrees.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Resolves the canonical repository root directory using git commands, with fallback for environments lacking git common-dir support.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Enters or creates a git worktree for a specific pull request, optionally resetting to main.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Fetches pull request metadata from GitHub using gh CLI and outputs JSON.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Writes PR metadata JSON to a file and extracts specific fields into environment variables.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists existing PR-related worktrees with their PR number, directory, and status info.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Removes merged or closed PR worktrees, with an option for dry run.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a worktree directory name.
